newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Record volume seen in Estonia shares for 2nd day.
newsitem.headline: Record volume seen in Estonia shares for 2nd day.

text.p: Volume in Estonian shares. boosted by Hansapank and Forekspank, hit record levels for the second day on Wednesday.
Official list volume was 65.6 million kroons compared with 50.3 million on Tuesday, and the index gained 4.7 percent to 129.04.
Hansapank climbed nearly six kroons from 127.25 to 133.
The rally was sparked by news that the bank is being quoted on the Frankfurt stock exchange but some dealers also said the company has been under-priced.
"I cannot understand where these orders come from but I would be surprised if only Estonian investors are behind that," said one foreign broker of the share price rise.
Forekspank also had healthy volume, notching up trade of 20.6 million kroons and closing at 81.75 kroons after 81 kroons.
Dealers earlier said that given a lack of corporate news, investors seemed to be hoping for positive 1997 results.
The free market was also active on turnover of 18 millions kroons with plastics maker Norma the most active on trade of 13.1 million kroons but it closed lower at 33 kroons versus 35.75 kroons.
